コメント(良い点): The hotel was conveniently located, just a short walk from the station. Several local shops nearby. 10 mins from the main shopping centre. Lots of restaurants nearby. Breakfast is very reasonable.  Overall this Hotel was very adequate for our needs, but certainly not luxury.
コメント(改善点): The room was small, which is common for city hotels. The bathroom was very small and the bath very small and difficult to get in and out of if sitting down in it.!! Fridge was provided, microwave was not, but there's a shared microwave down in the lobby. The staff was friendly and could speak enough English that communication was not a problem. They also held my luggage for me, with number tag to ensure no one else could "mistakenly" take them, on both my checkin and checkout days. And even if they do not clean your room on a certain day, they will provide a new set of towels and toiletries for you.
コメント(改善点): The bed is decent but the pillows were thin and terrible. I didn't try the buffet breakfast as $12-$16 CAD extra per day pushed it into Not Worth It territory, considering there are supermarkets and convenience stores nearby. The front lobby is exceptionally cramped, though that's not really something you can fix.
